newsitem.title: CHINA: Far East Cons. yearly profit up 5.16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Far East Cons. yearly profit up 5.16 pct.

text.p: Company name Far East Consortium International
NOTE - Far East Consortium is an investment holding and property investment company.

The company proposed a bonus issue of one 1998 warrant and one 1999 warrant for every 10 shares held. The 1998 warrants are expected to be issued up to October 31, 1998 at the price of HK$2.20 per share and 1999 warrants are expected to be issued up to October 31, 1999 at the price of HK$3.20 per share.

Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$15 million on disposal of investment properties and fixed assets, and gain of HK$14.42 million on provision for diminution in value of long-term listed investment written back/(made).
The calculation of share earnings are based on the weighted average of 769.36 million shares vs 743.04 million shares.
Total dividend for year is nine H.K. cents (including interim dividend of three cents) vs eight cents.
